Guild Overview

Welcome to the Lords of Chaos Dungeon Runners posse. We have been dealing out digital death to monsters and each other since 1997. If you are looking for a posse of honorable gamers then the Lords of Chaos might be for you.

Latest News

Welcome all new members. Glad to have you in posse.

I have started working on a website. It's not much but should be enough to get our message across. Please feel free to check it out and join our forums.

We are always looking for allies, that we can be friends with and so our members can help each other out. If your posse would like to become allies with ours please feel free to join our forums or contact me (Ghostwheel) in the game.

Grats to Genericname72, GrafEisen and IndySkyz on hitting 100! Welcome to the club bros.
